content.what_it_is: MATLAB nesting tool: single-block variant of make_stations_multi_blocks.m generating a station list for one nested-grid boundary. Station spacing dx=6.0/3600.0 degrees (L3; finer than the multi-block script's 60/3600). One bounding box labeled 'Wilmington NC' in the comment (L7) but with coordinates lon -72.0..-70.85, lat 41.1..41.9 (L8-L11). Builds x, y vectors (L13-L14) and appends rows (lat, lon, side_id) to sta for the four sides with side IDs 1-4: east at x(end) (L17-L24), west at x(1) (L26-L33), south at y(1) (L35-L42), north at y(end) (L44-L51). Checks total count against 2*length(x)+2*length(y) (L53), plots the outline (L55-L59) and prints plots/NestRI_NA.jpg (L61), then writes all rows in '%f %f %d' format to station_NA.txt (L66-L68).
entities: dx station spacing in degrees L3
j latitude loop index L19, L28
i longitude loop index L37, L46
sta station table (lat, lon, side_id) L21-L23
calls: length L19, L28, L37, L46, L53, L58
unresolved: comment says 'Wilmington NC' (L7) but the coordinates lon -72..-70.85, lat 41.1..41.9 (L8-L11) are in the Rhode Island/Massachusetts area, matching the output names NestRI_NA.jpg (L61) and station_NA.txt (L66); the comment appears stale
the coupling_file_single_block.m consumer loads station_WI.txt, not station_NA.txt written here (L66); the file pair correspondence is inconsistent within this directory
comment '% 60 times' (L3) is copied from the multi-block script though dx here is 6/3600 (0.1 arcminute); icount_last (L63) is assigned but never used
